rooms.theme_en: From the balloon you see the whole resort: every department runs on information systems, and they are all connected. Three landing routes: the clubhouse (main story), the old town (suppliers) and the lake (remote work, IoT and the SOC).
rooms.lesson_zh: 人、流程、科技、資料合起來才是資訊系統。
rooms.theme_zh: 從熱氣球上看整個渡假村：每個部門都靠資訊系統運作，系統之間彼此相連。三條降落路線：會館（主線）、老城（供應商）、湖上（行動辦公、物聯網、資安監控中心）。
rooms.lesson_en: People, processes, technology and data together make an information system.

rooms.theme_en: Guests arrive here, check in on the PMS and look for the Wi-Fi sign to get online.
rooms.lesson_zh: 訪客和員工網路要隔開；收集客人資料時要先告知用途。
rooms.theme_zh: 客人在這裡抵達，用 PMS 辦報到，再看 Wi-Fi 牌子連上網路。
rooms.lesson_en: Keep guest and staff networks apart, and tell guests how their data is used when you collect it.

rooms.theme_en: Orders go from the POS to the kitchen display and cards are paid on encrypted terminals; card data is the most tightly regulated data here.
rooms.lesson_zh: 不能存安全碼和 PIN，卡號要遮罩；收銀電腦上收到奇怪的信先別點。
rooms.theme_zh: 點餐從 POS 送到廚房螢幕，用加密的刷卡機付款；信用卡資料是這裡管得最嚴的資料。
rooms.lesson_en: Never store the CVV or PIN, mask card numbers, and treat unexpected emails on the POS PC with suspicion.

rooms.theme_en: Every bottle is scanned into the ERP; POS sales reduce stock and low stock creates purchase orders to suppliers.
rooms.lesson_zh: 操作紀錄和職務分離，讓同一個人不能又盤點又改庫存。
rooms.theme_zh: 每瓶酒都掃條碼進 ERP；POS 賣出就扣庫存，庫存不夠就產生採購單給供應商。
rooms.lesson_en: Audit trails and segregation of duties stop one person from both counting and adjusting stock.

rooms.theme_en: Badge readers, CCTV and the visitor log guard the staff-only area; the policy board here holds the clues for both locked doors: passphrase length and screen-lock minutes for the banquet hall's MFA door, and the SOC's extension, which also opens the staff gate to the Lake Pavilion.
rooms.lesson_zh: 刷卡門不要讓人跟著進來，訪客要有人陪同。
rooms.theme_zh: 門禁讀卡機、監視器和訪客登記守著員工區；這裡的政策公告是兩道鎖的線索：密語長度和螢幕鎖定的分鐘數開宴會廳的多因素驗證門，資安監控中心的分機也能開往湖心館的員工通道。
rooms.lesson_en: Don't let anyone follow you through a badge door, and escort visitors.

rooms.theme_en: The help desk handles tickets, account requests and changes, and keeps the asset inventory (CMDB).
rooms.lesson_zh: 權限照職務核准；重設密碼前一定要核對身分。
rooms.theme_zh: 服務台處理報修單、帳號申請和變更，也管資產清冊（CMDB）。
rooms.lesson_en: Access is approved by job role, and password resets need an identity check.

rooms.theme_en: Staff learn to spot phishing, use strong passwords and MFA, and report anything strange.
rooms.lesson_zh: 人也是資安的一環：訓練和演練能讓人少點錯。
rooms.theme_zh: 員工在這裡學會認出釣魚信、用好密碼和多因素驗證、看到怪事就回報。
rooms.lesson_en: People are part of security: training and phishing drills mean fewer wrong clicks.

rooms.theme_en: The banquet hall door asks for two factors: something you know (the code from the corridor policy board) and something you have.
rooms.lesson_zh: 重要系統不能只靠密碼。
rooms.theme_zh: 宴會廳的門要兩種驗證：你知道的（走廊政策公告上的密碼）加上你擁有的。
rooms.it_zh: 宴會廳門口・多因素驗證
rooms.lesson_en: A password alone is not enough for important systems.

rooms.theme_en: A wrong code is rejected and logged; repeated failures would lock the account and alert the SOC.
rooms.lesson_zh: 登入失敗是要注意的警訊。
rooms.theme_zh: 輸錯被拒絕，也被記錄；連續失敗會鎖帳號並通知資安監控中心。
rooms.it_zh: 宴會廳門口・驗證失敗
rooms.lesson_en: Failed logins are a warning sign to watch, not just a nuisance.

rooms.theme_en: Both factors check out and the door opens: authentication is done, and authorization now decides what you may do inside.
rooms.lesson_zh: 驗證是確認你是誰，授權是決定你能用什麼。
rooms.theme_zh: 兩種驗證都通過，門打開了：身分驗證完成，接著由授權決定你能做什麼。
rooms.it_zh: 宴會廳門口・驗證通過
rooms.lesson_en: Authentication proves who you are; authorization decides what you may access.

rooms.theme_en: Event registrations feed the CRM; marketing may use guests' data only for what they agreed to.
rooms.lesson_zh: 只收需要的資料，客人說不要行銷就要停。
rooms.theme_zh: 活動報名資料進到 CRM；行銷只能在客人同意的範圍內使用。
rooms.lesson_en: Collect only what you need and stop marketing when a guest says no.

rooms.theme_en: Smart lights and the fireworks controller run on the network, and staff phones are at the party too.
rooms.lesson_zh: 物聯網設備要改掉預設密碼，放在獨立的網段。
rooms.theme_zh: 智慧燈光和煙火控制器都接在網路上，員工的手機也在現場。
rooms.it_zh: 花園派對・物聯網與 OT
rooms.lesson_en: Change default passwords and keep IoT devices on their own network.

rooms.theme_en: Digital signs and a public kiosk show event information; cameras watch the plaza. After 21:00 the bridge to the Lake Pavilion is a staff gate: its code is the SOC's extension, the number you call to report phishing.
rooms.lesson_zh: 公共螢幕要鎖好；有監視器的地方要告知。
rooms.theme_zh: 數位看板和公共資訊站顯示活動資訊，廣場有監視器。晚上九點以後，往湖心館的橋頭是員工通道，密碼是資安監控中心的分機，也就是回報釣魚要打的號碼。
rooms.it_zh: 湖邊廣場・數位看板與資訊站
rooms.lesson_en: Lock down public screens and tell people where cameras record them.

rooms.theme_en: Dashboards turn POS and booking data into KPIs such as occupancy, ADR and RevPAR.
rooms.lesson_zh: 資料要整理、整合、給對的人看，才會變成資訊和知識。
rooms.theme_zh: 儀表板把 POS 和訂房資料變成住房率、平均房價、每間可售房收入這些指標。
rooms.it_zh: 湖心館大廳・BI 儀表板
rooms.lesson_en: Data becomes information and knowledge only when it is cleaned, combined and shown to the right people.

rooms.theme_en: The staff awards night celebrates each department's security work; the new IT staff member can win Security Champion.
rooms.lesson_zh: 資安要持續改善：計畫、執行、檢查、改進。
rooms.theme_zh: 員工頒獎晚會表揚各部門的資安成果，新人有機會拿到資安新人獎。
rooms.it_zh: 湖心館劇場・頒獎晚會
rooms.lesson_en: Security is continual improvement: plan, do, check, act.

rooms.theme_en: Look back over the resort and review what you learned.
rooms.lesson_zh: 每個部門、系統和人都在保護資料。
rooms.theme_zh: 回頭看整個渡假村，複習今天學到的。
rooms.it_zh: 搭熱氣球回家・總複習
rooms.lesson_en: Every department, system and person plays a part in protecting data.

rooms.theme_en: Servers, storage, network gear, the UPS and the on-site backup sit behind a locked door; entering without authorization sets off the alarm (bad ending).
rooms.lesson_zh: 只有授權的人能進機房，每次進出都有紀錄。
rooms.theme_zh: 伺服器、儲存設備、網路設備、不斷電系統和本地備份都在上鎖的門後；沒授權闖進來會觸發警報（壞結局）。
rooms.lesson_en: Only authorized people enter the server room, and every entry is logged.

rooms.theme_en: Someone clicked a phishing link on the POS PC; ransomware encrypted the systems and the restaurant cannot take orders (bad ending).
rooms.lesson_zh: 離線備份、網段隔離和演練過的應變計畫，決定多快能恢復。
rooms.theme_zh: 有人在收銀電腦點了釣魚連結，勒索軟體把系統加密，餐廳沒辦法點餐（壞結局）。
rooms.it_zh: 夜晚的餐廳・收銀系統停擺
rooms.lesson_en: Offline backups, segmentation and a practised response plan decide how fast you recover.

rooms.theme_en: The emergency assembly point; the business continuity plan says how the resort keeps running when systems or power fail.
rooms.lesson_zh: 事先知道自己的工作在系統掛掉時怎麼用人工替代。
rooms.theme_zh: 緊急集合點；營運持續計畫寫著系統或電力出問題時渡假村怎麼繼續營運。
rooms.it_zh: 湖邊草地・集合點與營運持續
rooms.lesson_en: Know the manual fallback for your job before you need it.

rooms.theme_en: Suppliers deliver by boat; vendors also deliver software, support and remote access.
rooms.lesson_zh: 廠商要先評估；對方說要換匯款帳戶，一定打電話確認。
rooms.theme_zh: 供應商從碼頭送貨；廠商也提供軟體、維護和遠端連線。
rooms.it_zh: 會館碼頭・進貨與廠商
rooms.lesson_en: Assess vendors before trusting them, and confirm any change to their bank details by phone.

rooms.theme_en: The Wi-Fi sign tells guests how to join the guest network.
rooms.lesson_zh: 公開的牌子上只能放訪客網路的資訊。
rooms.theme_zh: Wi-Fi 說明牌告訴客人怎麼連訪客網路。
rooms.it_zh: 露台近看・Wi-Fi 說明牌
rooms.lesson_en: Only guest network details belong on a public sign.

rooms.theme_en: The POS terminal, card terminal and receipt printer up close.
rooms.lesson_zh: 收據只印卡號末四碼；密碼不能貼在便利貼上。
rooms.theme_zh: 近看收銀機、刷卡機和收據印表機。
rooms.lesson_en: Receipts show only the last four digits, and passwords never go on sticky notes.

rooms.theme_en: A shared tablet servers use to take orders at the tables.
rooms.lesson_zh: 共用裝置要自動鎖定，每個人用自己的帳號登入。
rooms.theme_zh: 服務生在桌邊點餐用的共用平板。
rooms.lesson_en: Shared devices lock automatically and everyone logs in as themselves.

rooms.theme_en: The barcode scanner and the ERP stock screen.
rooms.lesson_zh: 調整庫存要另一個人核准，而且留下紀錄。
rooms.theme_zh: 條碼掃描器和 ERP 的庫存畫面。
rooms.it_zh: 酒吧近看・掃描器與庫存畫面
rooms.lesson_en: Stock adjustments need a second person's approval and leave an audit trail.

rooms.theme_en: The ticket board shows open requests: new accounts, access changes and password resets.
rooms.lesson_zh: 每個職務只給它需要的最少權限。
rooms.theme_zh: 工單看板列出待處理的申請：開帳號、改權限、重設密碼。
rooms.it_zh: 服務台近看・工單看板
rooms.lesson_en: Give each role the minimum access it needs.

rooms.theme_en: The banquet stage with tonight's award programme; the awards themselves are presented in the Lake Pavilion theatre.
rooms.lesson_zh: 被表揚的好習慣比較容易留下來。
rooms.theme_zh: 宴會廳的舞台，上面是今晚的頒獎流程；頒獎在湖心館劇場舉行。
rooms.lesson_en: Recognition helps good security habits stick.

rooms.theme_en: A big screen showing the event's CRM dashboard.
rooms.lesson_zh: 公共區域的螢幕不能顯示客人的個資。
rooms.theme_zh: 大螢幕上顯示活動的 CRM 儀表板。
rooms.it_zh: 宴會廳電視近看・CRM 畫面
rooms.lesson_en: Screens in public areas must not show guests' personal details.

rooms.theme_en: The KPI wall: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and restaurant revenue.
rooms.lesson_zh: 指標要大家都知道怎麼算才有用。
rooms.theme_zh: KPI 牆：住房率、平均房價、每間可售房收入、餐廳營收。
rooms.it_zh: 大廳水池對面・KPI 牆
rooms.lesson_en: A KPI is only useful if everyone knows how it is calculated.

rooms.theme_en: Posters of each department's security improvements this year.
rooms.lesson_zh: 資安不只是資訊部的事，每個部門都有份。
rooms.theme_zh: 各部門今年資安改善的海報。
rooms.lesson_en: Security is every department's job, not only IT's.

rooms.it_en: Corridor Far End · Server Room Entrance
rooms.theme_en: The server room door with its badge reader and camera.
rooms.lesson_zh: 限制區的門每次都要關好、鎖好。
rooms.theme_zh: 機房門口的讀卡機和監視器。
rooms.lesson_en: A restricted door must close and lock behind you every time.

rooms.theme_en: The old town's shops are the resort's suppliers, and each one connects to the resort in its own way.
rooms.lesson_zh: 你的資安強度，取決於最弱的那個供應商。
rooms.theme_zh: 老城的店家都是渡假村的供應商，各自用不同方式跟渡假村連線。
rooms.lesson_en: Your security is only as strong as your weakest supplier.

rooms.theme_en: The bakery receives the resort's orders through the supplier portal.
rooms.lesson_zh: 供應商的每個人都要有自己的帳號，不能共用。
rooms.theme_zh: 麵包店透過供應商入口網站接渡假村的訂單。
rooms.it_zh: 麵包店・供應商入口網站
rooms.lesson_en: Every supplier user needs their own login, never a shared one.

rooms.theme_en: The stained glass shows the principles of personal data protection.
rooms.lesson_zh: 個資只用在當初的目的、保持正確、保管好、時間到就刪。
rooms.theme_zh: 彩繪玻璃畫的是個資保護的原則。
rooms.lesson_en: Use personal data only for its purpose, keep it accurate and safe, and delete it on time.

rooms.theme_en: The breakwater keeps the waves out like a firewall; the small light warns of intrusions like an IDS.
rooms.lesson_zh: 縱深防禦：只有防火牆不夠。
rooms.theme_zh: 防波堤擋住外面的浪，就像防火牆；小燈塔像入侵偵測，有狀況就亮起來。
rooms.lesson_en: Defence in depth: a firewall alone is not enough.

rooms.theme_en: The resort sells rooms and souvenirs online through the booking engine and web shop, and a payment gateway handles payments.
rooms.lesson_zh: 付款頁和網站要防側錄和攻擊。
rooms.theme_zh: 渡假村在網路上賣房間和紀念品，付款交給金流閘道。
rooms.lesson_en: Protect the payment page and the website from skimming and attacks.

rooms.theme_en: Real incidents that changed security practice: Target, Marriott, MGM Resorts, WannaCry and more.
rooms.lesson_zh: 很多有名的事件都從很基本的地方開始：廠商帳號、沒修補的漏洞、一通電話。
rooms.theme_zh: 真實發生過、改變資安做法的事件：Target、Marriott、MGM 渡假村、WannaCry 等。
rooms.lesson_en: Most famous breaches started with something basic: a vendor login, a missing patch, a phone call.

rooms.theme_en: Soil and weather sensors send data through a gateway to the resort's systems.
rooms.lesson_zh: 物聯網設備跟電腦一樣要更新、要改密碼。
rooms.theme_zh: 土壤和氣象感測器透過閘道器把資料送進渡假村的系統。
rooms.it_zh: 薰衣草農莊・智慧感測器
rooms.lesson_en: IoT devices need updates and changed passwords like any computer.

rooms.it_en: Steamer Deck · Working on the Move
rooms.theme_en: Staff work from laptops and phones on the move and connect back through the VPN.
rooms.lesson_zh: 用 VPN、裝置要上鎖、掉了馬上通報。
rooms.theme_zh: 員工在移動中用筆電和手機工作，透過 VPN 連回公司。
rooms.it_zh: 蒸汽船甲板・行動辦公
rooms.lesson_en: Use the VPN, lock your device and report a lost one at once.

rooms.theme_en: The saloon offers open Wi-Fi to passengers, including a suspicious look-alike network.
rooms.lesson_zh: 把公共 Wi-Fi 當成不安全：開 VPN，不做管理工作。
rooms.theme_zh: 船艙提供乘客公共 Wi-Fi，其中還有一個名字很像的可疑熱點。
rooms.it_zh: 蒸汽船船艙・公共 Wi-Fi
rooms.lesson_en: Treat public Wi-Fi as hostile: VPN on, no admin work.

rooms.theme_en: A copy of the data rows away from the resort: the offsite copy of the 3-2-1 backup rule.
rooms.lesson_zh: 三份資料、兩種媒介、一份放別處；再留一份離線或不可改的副本防勒索軟體。
rooms.theme_zh: 一份資料被划離渡假村：3-2-1 備份原則裡放在別處的那一份。
rooms.it_zh: 湖面上的小船・異地備份
rooms.lesson_en: Keep 3 copies on 2 kinds of media with 1 offsite, plus one offline or immutable copy against ransomware.

rooms.theme_en: The SOC watches logs from every system around the clock; the keeper's log is the security log.
rooms.lesson_zh: 從日誌裡找出不尋常的模式，就是資料探勘的異常偵測。
rooms.theme_zh: 資安監控中心全天候看著各系統的日誌；守燈人日誌就是資安日誌。
rooms.lesson_en: Finding unusual patterns in logs is data mining at work: anomaly detection.

rooms.theme_en: Up close, each window panel names one privacy principle.
rooms.lesson_zh: 目的、最小化、正確、保存期限、安全、問責。
rooms.theme_zh: 近看每一片彩繪玻璃各寫著一個個資原則。
rooms.lesson_en: Purpose, minimisation, accuracy, storage limits, security and accountability.

rooms.theme_en: The sensor gateway box that connects the farm to the network.
rooms.lesson_zh: 看一下標籤：預設密碼和舊韌體就是敞開的門。
rooms.theme_zh: 把農莊接上網路的感測閘道器。
rooms.it_zh: 農莊近看・感測閘道器
rooms.lesson_en: Check the label: default passwords and old firmware are open doors.

rooms.theme_en: Raw data from many systems pools here before analysts turn it into reports.
rooms.lesson_zh: 資料湖也要分級和權限控管，不然會變成資料沼澤。
rooms.theme_zh: 各系統的原始資料匯進這裡，再由分析師整理成報表。
rooms.lesson_en: A data lake still needs classification and access control, or it turns into a data swamp.

rooms.theme_en: New systems grow in the greenhouse first: changes are tested here before going live.
rooms.lesson_zh: 測試和正式環境要分開，測試用假資料。
rooms.theme_zh: 新系統先在溫室裡長大：變更先在這裡測試，再上線。
rooms.lesson_en: Keep test and production apart, and test with fake data.

rooms.theme_en: Electronic locks, smart thermostats and TVs connect each villa to the resort's systems.
rooms.lesson_zh: 客房的科技要安全，客人走了也要把他的資料清掉。
rooms.theme_zh: 電子門鎖、智慧溫控和電視把每間別墅連上渡假村的系統。
rooms.lesson_en: Room technology must be secure and must forget the guest when they leave.

rooms.theme_en: Inside the suite, the smart TV, voice controls and key card show how much guest data one room holds.
rooms.lesson_zh: 退房時把每台裝置重設，下一位客人才不會看到前一位的資料。
rooms.theme_zh: 套房裡的智慧電視、語音控制和房卡，看得出一間客房存了多少客人資料。
rooms.it_zh: 湖畔別墅套房・客人隱私
rooms.lesson_en: Reset every device at checkout so the next guest never sees the last one's data.
